headline: This 2018 law expands VA memorial headstone and marker eligibility for certain family members of veterans whose remains are unavailable.
what_it_does: The law sets one consistent eligibility date for VA memorial headstones and markers for eligible spouses and dependent children of veterans whose remains cannot be recovered or are otherwise unavailable. It extends eligibility to dependent children and remarried spouses who died on or after November 11, 1998. The law was enacted March 16, 2018.

who_it_affects.group: Dependent children of veterans whose remains are unavailable
who_it_affects.how: Children who died on or after November 11, 1998 may now qualify for a VA memorial headstone or marker.

who_it_affects.group: Remarried spouses of veterans whose remains are unavailable
who_it_affects.how: Remarried spouses who died on or after November 11, 1998 may now qualify for a VA memorial headstone or marker.

who_it_affects.group: Families of veterans whose remains are unavailable
who_it_affects.how: Families may be able to obtain a VA memorial marker for an eligible relative under the expanded date.

when_it_takes_effect: The eligibility date covers deaths on or after November 11, 1998; the summary does not state a separate start date beyond enactment on March 16, 2018.
